column1: # Kit-owned: replaced on every `aapp install` / `aapp upgrade`. Never edit it in
# an adopter project. Your own plugins need no row: put them in
# .agents/skills/<name>/ and `aapp plugins` lists them under "Your Plugins".
#   state   : shipped | planned:<plan-id> (name reserved before the plugin ships)
#   events  : Plugin Payload Standard events the kit sends, comma-separated (- = none)
#   counter : git config key shown as the local fallback when absent (- = none)
#   sample  : shipped sample path under the kit (- = none)
